field_schema.id: int, dense, stable for the pin
field_schema.name: Forge face name (as XMage reports it, modulo accents)
field_schema.file: Forge script path relative to cardsfolder/tokenscripts
field_schema.face_index: 0 for single-face; face order for multi-face
field_schema.mana_cost: Forge mana string or null (no cost)
field_schema.colors: WUBRG mask string, e.g. 'UB'; from cost symbols and Colors:
field_schema.pt_star: 1 if power or toughness is * / X / CDA-defined
field_schema.graph: 68 floats, rl/e2_extract.py FEATURES order, this face only
field_schema.graph_union: 68 floats, union over faces (multi-face only, else null)
